en:
Look at me. Kamurocho picked me back
up when I was at rock bottom.

If you're planning to get your hands dirty,
I'd rather you use mine instead.
Kiryu-aniki. The others bail yet?
They're gone.
You had something to say to me, Nagumo?

Tsuneo Iwami's gonna head t'the shipyard
tomorrow fer Takeru Kurusu's funeral.
You're sure?

They're callin' it a Yomei succession ceremony.
They'll be comin' from across Hiroshima.
Ino looked into it fer me.
I heard Sugai's gonna be there, too.

Y'know, I'll do whatever it takes t'see
them dead. Ya with me on that, Aniki?
It's gotta be jus' the two of us, though.

We can't let anyone else get involved.
Not the rest o' the family, n' not Akiyama-san.
I was thinking the same.

When we die, at least we'll go
together... As brothers.

Probly the first bit o' good news
I've heard all day.
I'm ready t'get goin' whenever.
I know yer probly not ready yet, Aniki.
Take yer time sayin' goodbye t'Kamurocho.
I'll be waitin' fer ya in Serena.

Lemme know once y'finish all yer business.
Later.

(This is my final night in Kamurocho.
Whatever's ahead, I need to be ready.)

Aniki. Yer done doin' what y'needed
t'do in Kamurocho, right?

If y'are, we can finally go put all this t'bed.
So how 'bout it?

No, I'm not ready yet.
Give me a little more time.
All right, let's do it.

Somethin' wrong?
I ain't done with ya yet!

C'mon!
That ain't enough t'stop me!

Oh, Kiryu-chi.
Wanna play a game with me?
Damn right ya do!
Aw... Kinda lame, man.
Well, gimme a rematch sometime!

Hmmm?
You want to play against <font_kind=yakuza_italic>me</font_kind>?
Sure! <symbol=note_with_outline>
What? Boooring!
Let's play again sometime!

My, are you perhaps inviting
me to a darts match?

Sure.
Let's have some fun. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Oh. That's unfortunate...
See you next time. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
You wanna play, Kiryu-san?
This'll be my win.
Rejection hurts, man.
Holler at me anytime!
Oh? You want to play?
I'll take you on.
Let's play again soon. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Welcome.
For how many people?
Very well. That will be \500.
I'll show you to your room.

Very well.
We await your return.
It will be \1,000 for two people.
Please enjoy your time here.

Thank you for your patronage.
We await your return.

Your time is almost up...
Would you like to extend your time?
It will cost \500 to extend your time.

Very well.
Please continue to enjoy your time here.

Your time is almost up.
Please begin preparing to leave.

Very well. Please be sure to take all
of your belongings when you leave.
I apologize.
For one.
For two.
I want to call someone over.
I'd like more time.
No, it's fine.
I'll come back another time.

Welcome, welcome.
What do you want to do today?

Okay, then. Please drop in again
if you're ever in the mood.

This store is known for our Lullaby Battle Royale,
a blazing battle against our top three players.

If you want to compete, you'll have to meet the
following conditions and pay a participation fee.

I'm sorry, but it looks like you don't
qualify for the battle royale right now.

Come back and talk to me once
you manage to meet the conditions.
Congrats! You're qualified for our battle royale!

All you have to do now is pay the participation
fee and you'll be ready to rumble.

If you finish between 2nd place and 4th place,
your participation fee will go down the drain.

But if you somehow beat our champions,
you'll net a pretty hefty profit.

So, what'll it be? Do you want to
take on the Lullaby Battle Royale?

Sorry, but you don't have enough cash
to cover your participation fee.

Talk to me again once you have
a little more money on you.

Great, just hand over that fee and we'll be
ready to roll. Good luck... You'll need it.

Got it. Just talk to me again if you ever
feel like giving the battle royale a shot.

Nice try there. Please drop in again
if you're ever in the mood.

Congrats on your 1st place finish! Please
drop in again if you're ever in the mood.

If you wanna do the battle royale again,
you'll have to meet the conditions again, too.
Here's the point bonuses our parlor offers.

Welcome, sir. What are you
looking to do today?

Very well, then. We greatly
anticipate your next visit.

This store plays host to the Modern Battle Royale,
which pits you against our top mahjong experts.

If you wish to compete, we ask that you fulfill
these requirements and pay us a participation fee.

Unfortunately, it appears as though you
do not meet the necessary conditions.

Please return to this desk and notify me once
you have fulfilled the tasks at hand.

Congratulations, sir. You currently meet
the requirements for battle royale participation.

In order to continue onward to the event,
you must now pay your participation fee.

Please note that you will lose that fee if
you do not finish at the head of the table.

However, if you do indeed manage to win,
you will receive quite a generous prize sum.

Now then, what will you do, sir? Do you wish
to compete in the Modern Battle Royale?

It appears as though you lack the money
necessary to cover your participation fee.

Please return to this desk and notify me once
you have the required funds in your possession.

Excellent. Allow me to take your participation
fee, then. I wish you the best of luck today, sir.

Very well, sir. Please return to this desk and
notify me if you ever gain the necessary courage.

That was a good attempt, sir. We look forward
to your continued patronage in the future.

Well met, sir. Winning the table is quite the feat!
We look forward to your continued patronage.

If you wish to compete in the battle royale again,
we ask that you once again fulfill our requirements.

At this establishment, you will receive the
following bonus points depending on your rank.

Yo, how 'bout a bit of mahjong? As you can
probably tell, we're not the greatest players.
If you wanna play, it'll cost ya 12,500 yen.
Mkay, then. Fork up that cool 12,500.

That's a damn shame... I guess just
come back when you wanna play with us.

Hey, you wanna play mahjong with us?
If you do, it'll run ya 12,500 yen.

That was a real hoot.
Come back sometime, ya hear?

You up for some mahjong?
We're kinda good, if I do say so myself.

If you're looking to jump in, you'll
have to pay the 25,000 yen entry fee.

All righty. Just hand over that
25,000 and we'll be ready to go.

Well that's a downer... Just come talk
to me if you ever wanna play, okay?

You down to throw down, mahjong style?
It'll cost you 25,000 to play at this table.

They say luck changes with the tides...
Well, let's give it another go sometime.

Are you interested in some mahjong?
We are all pretty decent players.

If you'd like to join us, we only
ask that you put up 25,000 yen.
Wonderful. I'll be taking that 25,000 then.

Oh, I see... Well then, please come speak
to us again if you're ever interested.

Do you want to play with us? You'll just
need to put in 25,000 yen to join.

That was a good match.
Let's play together again sometime.

Could I interest you in a round of mahjong?
Though I must warn you, we are quite advanced.

If you wish to participate, we require
that you place a 50,000 yen bet.
Splendid. Now the 50,000, please.

How unfortunate. If you ever wish to put your
mahjong mettle to the test, please return to us.

Has our table piqued your interest? You will
need to place a 50,000 yen bet to join us.

My word... That result was quite unexpected.
Let us play again in the near future.
Oh, uh... Never mind.
Yeah. Let's see what this battle royale is all about.
No, maybe some other time.
Yeah, I'll give it a shot.
No, I think I'll pass.
Oh, Kiryu-san. What do you wanna do today?
Hey Captain! Thanks for coming!
(Hm, that guy looks pretty muscular.)
(I bet he would be a great asset for the Warriors.)
(Okay, then. I should see what his deal is.)

Hey, you.
Have you ever played baseball?
Hm? I played a long time ago.

In that case, why don't you join my team?
We're sorely lacking members right now.

Huh... Baseball sounds fun,
but I'm not feelin' it.
Why's that...?

I'm too hungry...
I want sooshee...
Oh! If you get me sooshee, I'll join your team!

(So he wants sushi, huh...
I guess I should buy some when I have time.)

If you get me sooshee,
I'll join your team!
Here, how's this?
Ah! Sooshee!

Mm, that was delicious!
Sooshee is the best!

Okay, I'll join your team! My name is Genie!
I look forward to playing together!
(All right, welcome aboard!)

(I'll need to keep finding players for the Warriors
if I want to help the team really succeed.)
(Wait, maybe I shouldn't give it to him...)

Hmmm, what am I gonna drink today? Maybe sake?
Don't really wanna give shochu up, though.

Hm? Baseball?
I used to play years ago.

Baseball, huh? I probly wouldn't mind joining you,
but I'm gonna need something in return first.
Don't worry, I'll keep it simple for you.

If y'couldn't tell, I'm a real boozer.
I'll join your team in exchange for a drink.

(I guess I could part with a bottle of
alcohol to get a new guy on the team...)
I'll join your team in exchange for a nice drink.
Wow, thanks man!

I'm all over that baseball shit now. The name's
Kuramoto, by the way. Can't wait to get started.

You could call it experience if you want...
I actually used to play professionally.

I was known as Maetani, the Samurai Slugger.
You've probably heard of me?
Uh, nope.
Really? Bah...

Anyway, why don't you join my team?
We're sorely lacking members right now.

Baseball, huh? It's been years since
I last played... but sure, why not?

That said, I've played professionally.
I have a signing fee to join up.

Let's see... A million yen oughta
cover me joining you peons.
(A million!? Is he worth it!?)

Don't balk, now. I used to clear 100 million
a year. Isn't that at a great deal?
That's a little too rich for my blood.

Very well. If you ever want to reconsider,
I guarantee you won't be disappointed.
Nice, it's all here then.

Now you've got my million
yen samurai slugging.

Call me Tomokazu Maetani.
Looking forward to the game.

How about a million yen? I'll gladly join
your team if you can provide me with that.

Hmmm... How can I make my body into
the temple it deserves to be?
Baseball, hm? I actually played years ago.

You really want me? I suppose I wouldn't mind,
but could I ask a favor of you beforehand?
What kind of favor?
Well, I've been really into bodybuilding recently.

On that note, I've heard this gym RIZAP
has been gaining traction all over Japan.

I would love to get my hands on their special protein,
but it's impossible to get out here in the boonies.

Sooo, if you bring me some RIZAP protein,
I'd be happy to join your baseball team.
(Hm... So he wants some protein from RIZAP.)
(I guess I'll buy some when I'm back in Kamurocho.)

If you bring me some RIZAP protein,
I'd be happy to join your baseball team.
Aha! This is protein from the world-famous RIZAP!
Mind if I try some right now?

Oooh! This feels incredible!
I'm getting more shredded as we speak!
(I don't think that's how it works...)

Yeah! You can ride the wave to the top
aboard my ripped new muscles!

I'm Takao Kawamura, by the way!
Let's do this!
Oh, Kurosawa-san, you look sleepy.

Well, I was watching a movie last night
and it kept me glued to it all night.

I watched it to the end, so I'm really
lacking sleep. Does that happen to you?
Oh yeah, that happens a lot.
Haha, yeah it does.
No, not for me.
Huh... Really...?
Hmm, I do sometimes.

Start watching a movie at night and not
being able to stop. I do that too.
By the way, this happened...

And what does that have to do with
what what we're talking about?
It doesn't really, sorry...

(I brought down the mood by talking
about unrelated things...)

It was that suspense thriller that was
on last night, right? I saw it too.

Wasn't it really good? I figured out
who the culprit was so early, though.

Really? I had no idea who it
was until the very end.

Yeah, 'cause you're an idiot. If you paid
attention, you could tell right away.

What...? So if I don't figure out who
the culprit is, I'm an idiot...?
Yeah, an idiot.
Hey, Kiryu-san, don't be so blunt...
But it's a suspense thriller, right?

Then it's nice, because you can be
surprised when the suspect is revealed.

Th-That's right... There are some
things that idiots can enjoy more...
No, that's not true.

It's fun to watch everything in the moment.
There are different ways to enjoy a movie.
